elements.element: Vendor (SFJ) owes a defence obligation to Customer
elements.evidence: "SFJ will indemnify and hold PB ... harmless" — no duty to defend is added anywhere

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates
elements.evidence: "indemnify and hold PB; its Affiliates and their respective officers, directors, employees and agents"

elements.element: Coverage of third-party claims alleging the services/deliverables infringe IP
elements.evidence: new "(g) any Claim by a Third Party alleging actual or alleged infringement or misappropriation of such Third Party's Intellectual Property by SFJ ... in performing SFJ's obligations"

elements.element: Coverage of claims arising from Vendor's breach of law
Coverage of data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: no data-breach or privacy/security limb appears in 12.1.1 as redlined

elements.element: Coverage of Vendor gross negligence / wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "(a) the gross negligence or willful misconduct of SFJ or any of its Affiliates"

elements.element: Standard indemnity procedure (notice, control of defence, cooperation)
elements.evidence: clause refers to "Indemnified Party" defined in Section 12.2.1, which is not supplied; no procedure added by the redline

elements.element: Customer's indemnity limited to Customer-provided content
elements.evidence: PB still indemnifies for "(a) a Product supplied by PB", "(e) any material breach of a Protocol by PB", "(g) injuries sustained by Subjects ... or from the Commercialization of the Product"

elements.element: Customer's indemnity limited to Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: "(d) PB's material breach of this Agreement" remains — breach of contract, not breach of law, and no such limitation is introduced
new limb "(g) any Claim by a Third Party alleging actual or alleged infringement or misappropriation of such Third Party's Intellectual Property by SFJ"

elements.element: Usual exclusions: Customer modifications, combinations, specifications
elements.evidence: only exclusions are "gross negligence or willful misconduct of any PB Indemnified Party or (ii) material breach of this Agreement ... by PB"

elements.element: Infringement remedies: procure, modify, replace, refund
elements.evidence: no remedy mechanic inserted; redline is limited to indemnity limbs

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3× annual fees
elements.evidence: no cap language appears in the redlined text

reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the redline only adds an IP-infringement limb and trims our own limb (f); it adds no duty to defend, no breach-of-law limb, and no Vendor-caused data-breach limb.

Our own indemnity in 12.1.2 remains far broader than the preferred position (Product supplied, material breach of Agreement, Protocol breach, Subject injuries, Commercialization) rather than being limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

Fallback is also incomplete on its own terms: no modification/combination/specification exclusions, no procure-modify-replace-refund remedies, and no 3x annual fees super-cap. Preferred and fallback cannot be mixed.
Indemnity procedure (notice, control, cooperation) is cross-referenced to Section 12.2.1, which is not before us, so that element cannot be verified.

Edits are appropriately narrow (one new limb plus a one-phrase narrowing of limb (f)) and do not disturb the tax-benefit netting, the existing carve-outs, or any untouched limb; the new limb carries its own exception so no dangling mechanic is created.
